local_grid_outlook: The local grid is dominated by sparse rural distribution with low growth in both production and consumption.
regional_grid_outlook: Beyond the local grids in the area, the regional grid serves industry expected to increase consumption sharply and wind power construction expected to increase production. A large share of the heavy industry undergoing the green transition is located here and will increase electricity consumption sharply.
production_outlook: In this area, particularly the southern parts within bidding zone SE2, there is a large production surplus from hydropower and wind power.
consumption_outlook: A large share of heavy industry undergoing the green transition will increase electricity consumption sharply. Other consumption: sparse rural distribution with low growth.
narrative_note: Source publishes this area as 'Norrland' (short label 'Norr' on maps). regions_or_counties reflects the §1.1 wording 'Vattenfall Eldistribution AB's local grid is found primarily in northern Norrland and northern parts of central Norrland'. The definitive municipality list comes from Annex 1.
